name: Verdant Colossus
description: In Tanares, the largest tree is not one of the colossal Mother Trees but an even larger sequoia. This tree, now a living fortress, was cultivated by Vollanas Deepleaf, one of the druid hierophants who led the crossing from their home plane to Tanares. He endeavored to bring many relics from his world to their new home, but after arriving, humans stole some of his sacred items. The loss of his world and the ancient artifacts he had sworn to protect caused Vollanas to lose his sanity, and he became obsessed with securing the relics from his world. He transformed the giant tree in the forest into his fortress to protect the remaining relics, creating a dungeon with multiple levels extending underground within its roots and branches. It is said to hold ancient elven relics and the possessions of many who dared to explore its depths and never returned. The dungeon has labyrinths of wooden passages and enchanted leaf walls. Those who perish within are transformed into plant-like guardians, eternally defending the tree. Rumors suggest a portal within it leads to the elven homeworld, now a frozen, lifeless expanse. Hierophant Bennalas forbade entry into the tree, but the few who defied him died or were forced to flee. In a scandalously kept secret, the king’s only son ventured into the tree to prove his courage but never returned. The queen, acting discreetly, has since offered rewards to adventurers who search for him, always choosing foreigners and maintaining her anonymity to avoid public attention. The Plant Guardians. It retains its original stats, but its type changes to Plant. It gains resistance to bludgeoning and piercing damage, vulnerability to fire damage, its speed is reduced by 5 ft. (to a minimum of 5 ft.), and it gains a natural armor bonus of +2 to AC.
